title: Brand mark and app icons
lead: Give larder a product mark and the icon set the PWA and the projects site need, following the squalor-xyz branding conventions.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the web manifest, service worker and copying icons into `src/larder/web/static/icons/` (PWA shell slice).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: larder has no logo, favicon or app icon. The PWA shell (S08) needs installable icons, the README needs a mark, and the squalor.xyz projects page needs a card image. Product-mark masters live in the private branding repo; public repos carry unmodified copies.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Concept: three rough drafts (preserve jar, shelf of jars, jar with list checks) shown side by side; owner picks or adjusts. Decided: owner reviews drafts before exports.
2. Scope: product mark plus a PWA/web set (192, 512, maskable 512, favicon-32, favicon-180, favicon.svg). Decided.
3. Site card: `Python · AGPL-3.0` with a repository link. Decided.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `../branding/generated/logos/larder/larder.svg` (master), `README.md`, `exports/` (larder-512, larder-192, larder-maskable-512, favicon.svg, favicon-32, favicon-180)
- `../branding` README, STYLE_GUIDE, generated/README, generated/logos/REVIEW, LICENSE §2 grant 2
- `assets/larder-512.png` (unmodified copy) and `README.md` in this repo
- `../squalor.xyz/docs/assets/larder.svg`, `docs/projects.html` card

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: None (asset slice; no application code yet).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Draft three 64×64 SVG concepts in teal `#6ee7d2` and cream `#f4efe7`, transparent field, no wordmark; owner picks.
2. Add the master and exports to the branding repo with Inkscape; maskable icon puts the mark in the inner 80% on `#0f1419`.
3. Document the mark in the branding tables and add the LICENSE grant for larder's copies.
4. Copy `larder-512.png` unmodified into `assets/` and show it in the README.
5. Add the larder card to the squalor.xyz projects page with an unmodified copy of the SVG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `xmllint --noout` passes on the master SVG.
- Export sizes are 512, 192, 180, 32 and 512 (maskable); `larder-512.png` is RGBA with a transparent field.
- Copies in this repo and the site are byte-identical to the branding masters (`cmp`).
- The projects page renders the card locally (`python3 -m http.server -d docs`).
- `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
